meta.baseline: KR/TW live, after the Sep 23 patch
meta.notice: Default view = Global Season 1: 4 stigma slots (confirmed on NC's official livestream) with stigma levels capped at 20 (reported by Global guides). Switch to KR/TW for the 6-slot, level-25 builds.
meta.note: Builds, tiers and priorities come from Korean Inven class boards (Jul 1 – Sep 29, 2026: guides, dummy tests and dungeon threads). Level-25 effects are KR/TW client tooltips; Lv 5–20 effects are from the Global client DB.

changelog.text: Review pass + new 'Skills to level' section for every class: which DPS and buff skills to take to 20 / 16 / 12, the first two to push, passive priority, and where skill levels come from (from the Sep 2026 Korean optimizer guides and Kanon's Aion 2 Bible). New 'Damage basics' panel (stat priority, crit cap, ping, raid accuracy/crit targets). Fixed: the KR/TW Gladiator cards treated Armor of Balance as a damage pick; a Jul 8 patch moved that boost to Wave Armor, so Focused Block takes the sixth slot. Global's 4 stigma slots are now confirmed (official livestream).

Global Season 1 view (now the default): 4-slot builds capped at level 20 for all 8 classes, a 'how high to level each' list with the reason to stop there, Season 1 level-up orders, and Korea's own 4-slot builds (Nov 2025 - Mar 2026) for comparison. New skill-specialization section: the 3 of 5 specialties to pick for each class's core skills, read from the Sep 2026 Korean optimizer screenshots and matched to the Global database's English options.

New Stigmas page: 6-slot builds with target levels for all 8 classes, level-up order with shard costs, unlock milestones, variants (Gladiator battle tank, Chanter battle healer, raid, solo, PvP), full 13-stigma tier lists, and the list from your image for comparison.

classes.imageNote: Same core as Korea. Korean players add Triniel's Dagger (their third level-25 pick) and Evasion Stance for stun mechanics.

builds.why: Illusive Clone and Swift Contract are your burst window (Heart Gore has no cooldown during Clone), so they get the first two level-25s. Triniel's Dagger is the third (+10% back damage at 25). Savage Fang is in the macro and adds +10% PvE damage at 15. Evasion Stance dodges stun mechanics. Throw Shadowblade is a ranged gap-closer and clears trash.

Assault Ambush gives +20% Attack for 5s on hit at level 5. Use it as the opener only when the boss dies in about 20s; otherwise its slow wind-up costs damage and Throw Shadowblade or Smoke Bomb is comfier.
src: Ambush vs Smoke Bomb vs Shadowblade

builds.why: Throw Shadowblade resets its cooldown on kills (Lv 10) and turns into an AoE (Lv 20), which makes pack farming fast. Keep Evasion Stance for elites.

Swift Contract's +10% Attack at 25, Smoke Bomb's Weakness at 25 and Evasion Stance's longer dodge are the picks Korean players keep. Their Aug 29 write-up says Assassin PvP stigmas are weak overall, so treat this as the least-bad set.

classes.imageNote: The exact core Korean Chanters use. The sixth slot is Healing Touch (party heal) or, in raids, Impeding Authority / Focused Defense.

builds.why: Undefeated Mantra (party damage and tolerance) and Power of the Storm (party combat speed and cooldowns) are why parties bring you: level them first and to 25. Sprint Mantra is the third 25. Marchutan's Wrath opens Dark Crush. Guardian Blessing must be at least 15 (x1.5 Wind's Promise). Healing Touch removes 5 debuffs at 15.

Keeps both party buffs and turns the rest into healing. Healing Touch 25 (-5s cooldown) is your burst heal and 5-debuff cleanse. Impeding Authority gives the party a 16%-HP shield, and 7% HP back when it breaks at 20. Sprint Mantra heals on hit. The guide author cleared Muspel boss 2 without a Cleric using these.

Tested on a clear: Storm 25 for the opening burst, Undefeated 25 over the Cleric's Light, and Guardian Blessing 25 for always-on damage tolerance. Impeding Authority pre-shields the jump-rope patterns. Focused Defense lets you block boss 1's block mechanic.

Since Sep 23, Undefeated Mantra and Power of the Storm do nothing while Battlefield Might is active (Abyss boss fights, Rifts, Time-Space battles). Free those slots: Marchutan's Wrath 20 adds heal reduction and a stun in PvP, and Focused Defense is your block.
The mantras are self-buffs too. Marchutan's Wrath keeps Dark Crush available. The guide author says solo Nightmare was much easier with Focused Defense.

builds.why: Corrode is the first 25 (+25% damage taken from you at 25). Players who dropped it saw damage fall sharply. Ancient Spirit 25 casts after 3 basic attacks instead of 5. Flame Blessing 25 adds +100% to its procs on bosses (Incapacitated Immunity). Benediction is party damage and tolerance. Full-charge Destructive Attack about 3–4s after summoning Ancient Spirit.

Benediction 25 (+3s) and Flame Blessing 25 tested about even. With the 3 leftover levels, some players put Benediction at 25 and Flame Blessing at 23, since Flame Blessing's duration also grows per level.
Siphon heals, and from 15 it shields you for 30% of max HP (+30% at 25). Players who moved their third 25 from Flame Blessing to Siphon report much easier survival.

builds.why: Dummy test, 5 × 1 min each: Vaizel + Bow of Blessing + Supporting Fire at 25 was the strongest trio (102.2% vs 100% for Vaizel + Bow + Griffon). Supporting Fire also lifesteals and doesn't care about boss invulnerability phases. The 6th slot is Mother Nature's Breath: damage stigmas there added only about 0.4%.
Some players get higher numbers in real dungeons with Griffon at 25 (+20% damage to targets with Crimson Flames). On the dummy it tests about 2% lower. Pick one and check your Ctrl+X meter.
Burst them down fast; the longer the fight, the worse for you. Ensnaring Trap strips buffs, Ambush Kick 25 gives 2s stealth, and Mother Nature cleanses damage-over-time.
